description.text: France's own McDonald's set of 2019, 40 cards to the 12 North America, Germany and the United Kingdom got. In October 2019 each Happy Meal in France held a four-card pack with two non-holo cards and two confetti holos, and every card came both ways. All 40 are Pokémon first found in Kanto, eight of them in their Alolan forms.
